question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**closely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes Drummle following her, implying that he was doing so with close attention.
 
• The adverb should denote the manner in which he was following her, which in this context is likely to be very attentively or without much distance.
 
• "**Closely**" fits well as it denotes following with close attention or proximity.
 
• Other options ("**firm**", "**sharpen**", "**intended**") do not accurately describe the manner of following in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
